name: Micheju
source: A Leone who showed talent as a magician after a past adventure, she is currently working as a member of the Guaracuna Trading Company. She is dedicated to honing her magical skills and has recently secured a permanent position. However, she has become a little gluttonous and is worried about gaining weight. Her good friend Ior, also a Leone, makes delicious snacks that she finds irresistible. She is positive about growing up and is a hard worker who does not mind making steady efforts. She has a polite and reliable personality. Additionally, the snowman that is always by her side was created unconsciously with magical powers, and she has a great aptitude for ice magic.
